title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1969-10-26

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with good clarity but a modest, mood‑focused show that falls short of the Dead’s peak performances.
ai_review.review: The tape is praised for its solid soundboard quality – listeners note a clear and well‑balanced mix. Musically the concert is described as a relaxed, “long‑weird‑weekend” vibe with an unnamed opening instrumental, but reviewers agree it isn’t one of the band’s stronger outings.

ai_rating.rationale: Recording quality is consistently rated good to excellent, while show quality is viewed as average or below‑average; weighted averaging yields a three‑star overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Several reviewers call the sound “fantastic” or “great”; no dropout or balance issues are mentioned, indicating a clean and clear board mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Partial show with an opening instrumental (possibly Runaround Sue‑style); overall mood is relaxed but the performance is not considered a highlight of the era.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Only his onstage banter about a "long, weird weekend" is noted; no specific comments on guitar work.
